---
name: Feature request
about: Describe a missing Desktop workflow or usability improvement.
---

## User need

What are you trying to accomplish, and what gets in the way today?

## Proposed experience

Describe the visible behavior you want. A sketch or example is welcome.

## Existing CLI or Focus behavior

If this is a parity request, include the command, arguments, runtime version,
and expected outcome. Otherwise, say that this is a Desktop-only presentation
request. Do not include credentials or private conversation content.

## Alternatives

What can you do today, and why is it insufficient? Link related issues or
existing documentation if known; implementation design is not required.
